answer: Grading seats here are staked per identity and rotated through a random ballot, so a fresh Sybil wallet starts at zero reputation and must post a cash bond before its work counts. Every clone pays that bond again, and a bad score forfeits it, so the attacker's cost scales with each fake account instead of one shared pool. One serious gale of fake submissions would burn the whole timber of the war chest, while honest miners keep their stake in a steady river of small rewards.
